title: hint-1
text: If you write x = 10 in Python, think about its data type. Is 10 written as a whole number or a decimal?

title: hint-2
text: Among the options, choose the type that represents whole numbers like 0, 5, or -12 — but not decimal values like 3.14.

title: hint-3
text: This type is the opposite of the float type. Floats contain decimals, but this type does not.
